value.rationale: The invariant is the generalized roundness and sharp Hilbert snowflake threshold of an essential graph-metric family, not an arbitrary table. The theorem provides a complete all-part-size classification, genuinely differing simple and high-nullity boundary phases, sharp strictness across all exponents and exact Euclidean embedding dimension. This extends a known bipartite special case to arbitrary multipartite configurations and supplies natural benchmarks for finite distance geometry.
